buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of The General Manager, SF Complex A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidders should submit the following documents with the Technical Bid: (a) GeM Tender document and Scope of Work (Price Bid format enclosed with Technical bid should be mar ked unpriced) duly signed by authorised signatory of the Bidder with Company seal to confirm compliance. (b) Copy of MSME, NSIC, registration with any DRDO lab. (If Applicable). (c) Bid Security Declaration duly signed by Bidder's Authorised Signatory of Bidder with seal in the attache d format. (d) Undertaking w.r.t enquiry by CBI/ED or any other Govt. agency in the attached format. (e). Minutes of Pre-Bid meeting duly signed by Bidder's authorised signatory with seal. (Pre-bid MoM would

be uploaded by Buyer Organisation after Pre-bid meeting). (f). Requirement of ePBG is deliberately selected as 'NO" so as to fix the performance security amount at " monthly payment due to the service provider (inclusive of taxes and duties) or 5% of the total order value ( whichever is lower)" and duration of ePBG shall be for 38 months. 2. Following documents are to be submitted with technical bid for compliance to Service Provider Qualification criteria of Scope of Work. (a). Registration with Central/State Govt by office of Registrar. (b). Documentary evidence i.r.o Work Experience. (c). Notarized affidavit stating that no legal cases are pending against the firm and firm is not blacklisted b y DRDO or any other Govt. Organisation. (d). Copy of GSTIN and PAN. (e). Documentary evidence i.r.o Annual Turnover. 3. Document to be submitted with price bid: (a) Price break-up in the format uploaded with this bid document duly signed by Authorised signatory of Bi dder with seal. All required fields in the said price bid format is to be properly filled and submitted. Total Pr ice for entire contract incl. of all taxes for 03 year contract period as arrived in price bid format must matc h total price quote entered on GeM Portal. (b). All highlighted fields in the said price bid format is required to be properly filled and submitted. Total p rice for 36 months arrived at in the said price bid format incl. taxes should match with the total offer price entered on GeM Portal. 4. Bidders are strongly advised to attend the Pre-bid Meeting. Bidders should mail a copy of authorisation l etter with details of their Authorised rep. attending the meeting to mmg-sfc1@gov.in at least one day be fore the scheduled date of Pre-Bid meeting. 5. Jurisdiction: Any legal or court cases pertaining to this contract shall fall under the jurisdiction of Chhatti sgarh. . 5. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff.
